question:
74. If you happen to read a formal letter having a salutation which reads as 'Dear Mr. Fetiya,' which one of the following could be the most appropriate closing?

A. Yours Sincerely
B. Yours Faithfully
C. Yours Obediently
D. Yours Faithfully

75. In a formal letter, which of the following could be optional?

A. The recipient's address
B. The salutation line
C. The date line
D. The subject heading

76. In a formal letter the recipient's address will be

A. below the sender's address
B. in the top right hand corner
C. at the bottom of the letter
D. below his or her name.
options: in the top right hand corner
at the bottom of the letter
